question: Can the held source layers form twenty inspectable dossiers without accepting candidate physical identities?
outcome: Twenty dossiers, 539 assertions, 138 missing-evidence rows and a local catalogue; 62 Dholavira candidate families and 274 edges retained; zero new empirical observations or physical merges.
challenge: Source layers use different locators and retain conflicting identifiers and incomplete face inventories.
remedy: Preserve source assertions, raw uncertainty and candidate membership, distinguish source-page views from accepted faces, and independently check structure, links and hashes.
retry_when: A source-qualified accession concordance, field item record, photograph binding or new reviewed image join becomes available.
